parameters.name: ImageURL
parameters.description:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).
Image format requirements:

- Image format: JPEG, JPG, PNG (8-bit, 16-bit, and 64-bit PNG images are not supported), and BMP.
- Image size: up to 3 MB.
- Image resolution: less than 2000 × 2000 pixels.
- The URL cannot contain Chinese characters.

parameters.name: ReturnForm
parameters.description:
The format of the returned image.

- If this parameter is not set, a 4-channel PNG image is returned.
- If this parameter is set to `mask`, a single-channel mask is returned.
- If this parameter is set to `whiteBK`, an image with a white background is returned.
- If this parameter is set to `crop`, a 4-channel PNG image with the blank areas around the edges cropped is returned.
